findings.finding: Fixed 36/12 layer assignment, 36/13 split including output, two GPU-specific offload counters, physical UUID manifest. Removed in the new campaign-local harness only.

Only BASE_LAYERS_0 and BASE_LAYERS_1 are read. Third and later first-seen layer devices receive zero base allowance plus common spare workspace. Safe bounds check, but extra VRAM cannot be budgeted normally.
Configured layer-byte ceilings and a common workspace allowance; not an automatic fit-to-free-VRAM planner. Standalone memory allowances must be retuned.
Dynamic maps keyed by backend. Two banks per backend are a double buffer, not a two-device limit. Each backend transition copies the current resident state.
Architecture-based Volta/Turing specialization, not a GPU0/GPU1 role. The new D256 path uses 1x32 on Volta and 1x8 on Turing.
Model-derived selection bound; multiple query rows and at least 32768 history entries. Gate is independent of number of GPUs.
QWEN4EXP adapter, one causal text sequence, CUDA layer backends, supported separate expert projections. No tensor/expert parallelism qualification.
Final output reads the resident store keyed by the output backend. Tests keep output with the final layer. Separate output-only or arbitrary placement is not qualified.
24 query heads, two KV heads, D256, 2051 selected bound and 100000 prefix are fixture assumptions; not two-device runtime restrictions.
